DECISIONS (spec-silent details): (1) remote-suppression precedence is offline > tainted > log-too-long (design lists tainted first; offline first keeps LB-7.1's OFFLINE on every offline high-score screen); a non-qualifying score 0 sets idle (online) / offline. (2) initialCabinet(false) starts with remoteStatus 'offline'; a successful start resets remoteStatus to idle/offline, remoteDetail, summary, highlightRank. (3) The initials 1800-tick timeout counts all ticks on the screen (keys do not reset it), per CC-7.3 'without a confirm'. (4) remoteStatus event detail is uppercased in the reducer; highlightRank is null until the app sends localSaved(rank). (5) localStore: missing key loads [] silently (overview §10 lists no warning for missing); corrupt/invalid entries warn once; unavailable storage warns once per session. (6) P7 pure: on shipped levels every 1-life recording ends in gameOver (<1000 ticks), so replay.property.test.ts adds a second property with the same opts plus maze: P5_MAZE that always hits maxTicks and asserts replay_incomplete for every claim. P1b also asserts its generator produced >=1 successful start and >=1 round trip.
